🔧 Construction Notes

Metal Stud Frame Construction

  • Studs: 70mm C-studs at 400mm centers
  • Plasterboard: 12.5mm on each side (25mm total coverage)
  • Foot Wall: 98mm total thickness (70mm stud + plasterboard)
  • Horizontal noggins: Required at shelf level (1200mm) and tablet mounting height (~975mm)
  • Wall termination: Rear wall structure ends at shelf top (1200mm); front/side walls continue to 2380mm

Flooring & Fixings

  • Floor type: Timber joists with thin board topping
  • Electrical cables: Running below flooring
  • Screw length: Maximum 25-30mm to avoid cable damage
  • Recommendation: Use grab adhesive + short screws; consider cable detection before drilling

Support & Structure

  • Bed support legs: 6 total (20mm × 20mm each)
  • Corner legs: 4 (one at each corner of bed frame)
  • Middle legs: 2 (positioned at 940mm from left edge - midpoint of 1900mm mattress + offset)
  • Drawer runners: Floor-mounted with 20mm clearance
  • Top clearance: 10mm between drawer tops and bed frame underside

💡 Lighting & Electronics

ESP32 Touchscreen (7")

  • Location: Rear shelf, centered horizontally
  • Vertical position: Midpoint between mattress top (750mm) and shelf top (1200mm) = 975mm
  • Function: Music control interface for corner speaker
  • Mounting: Flush-mounted requiring noggin support behind plasterboard

Lighting Systems (3 Types Recommended)

1. Ambient Lighting (Warm & Cosy)

  • Type: WS2812B addressable LED strips
  • Location: Under shelves (rear and head)
  • Color: Warm white (2700K-3000K) with optional RGB for mood
  • Controller: ESP32 with WLED firmware
  • Features: Dimmable, multiple preset patterns

2. Reading Light (Neutral White)

  • Type: Dimmable LED strip or spotlight
  • Location: Head wall or underside of rear shelf, directed at pillow area
  • Color Temperature: 4000K (neutral white, reduces eye strain)
  • Control: PWM dimming via ESP32
  • CRI: >90 for comfortable reading

3. Starfield Projection System (4 Options)

Option A - Fiber Optic Starfield (Most Realistic):

  • 200-400 fiber optic strands poked through black fabric/board mounted on ceiling area
  • RGB LED light source (single ESP32-controlled unit)
  • Random strand lengths create depth and twinkling variation
  • ESP32 controls color cycling and twinkle patterns

Option B - WS2812B Individual Star LEDs:

  • 50-100 individual addressable LEDs mounted on ceiling/walls
  • ESP32 + WLED for independent color and brightness control per "star"
  • Programmable twinkling patterns (random intensity variations)
  • Can create constellations, shooting stars, color shifts

Option C - Sky Projector Enhancement:

  • Small projector unit (laser or LED-based) mounted near head wall
  • ESP32-controlled rotation motor for slow movement
  • Projects realistic nebula/star patterns
  • Combine with fiber optics for layered depth effect

Option D - Mixed Reality (Fiber + Addressable LEDs):

  • 100 fiber optic strands for background "stars"
  • 20-30 WS2812B LEDs for "planets" and prominent stars
  • ESP32 coordinates both systems via WLED
  • Best balance of realism and programmability

ESP32 Wiring & Control

  • Central ESP32 board mounted inside head wall cavity
  • Power: 5V 10A supply (60W) for all LED systems
  • Touchscreen: I2C/SPI connection to ESP32
  • All lighting: Controlled via WLED web interface + touchscreen UI
  • Wire routing: Through stud wall cavities before plasterboard installation

⚠️ Safety Reminder:
  • Always use a cable detector before drilling or screwing into the floor
  • Maximum screw penetration: 25-30mm
  • Use grab adhesive as primary fixing method where possible
  • All electrical work should be performed by a qualified electrician
  • Ensure adequate fire safety compliance for enclosed sleeping spaces
